pyFBS.MK_model¶

Modul for import mass and stiffness matrix from Ansys, for calculating eigenvectors and eigenvalues and FRF synthesising using modal superposition method.

class pyFBS.MK_model(ress_file, full_file, no_modes=100, allow_pickle=True, recalculate=False)[source]¶

Initialization of the finite element model. Mass and stiffness matrices are imported and also nodes, DoFs and complete mesh of finite elements are defined. If parameter recalculate is Ture eigenvalues and eigenvectors are calculated. For faster processing by default pickle file is generated where mass and stiffness matrices are stored and also computed eigenvalues, eigenvectors and used number of modes. If changes are detected in the mass or stiffness matrix with respect to the stored pickle file, the calculation of eigenvalues and eigenvectors is repeated.

Parameters

  • ress_file (str) – path of the .rst file exported from Ansys

  • full_file (str) – path of the .full file exported from Ansys

  • no_modes (int) – number of modes to be included in output of the eigenvalue computation

  • allow_pickle (bool) – if True, pickle file will be generated to store data or will pickle file be used to load data

  • recalculate (bool) – if False just mass and stiffness matrices with corresponding nodes and their DoFs will be imported. If True also the eigenvalue problem will be solved.

FRF_synth(df_channel, df_impact, f_start=1, f_end=2000, f_resolution=1, limit_modes=None, modal_damping=None, frf_type='receptance')[source]¶

Synthetisation of frequency response functions using the mode superposition method.

Parameters

  • df_channel (pandas.DataFrame) – locations and directions of responses where FRFs will be generated

  • df_impact (pandas.DataFrame) – locations and directions of impacts where FRFs will be generated

  • f_start (int or float) – starting point of the frequency range

  • f_end (int or float) – endpoint of the frequency range

  • f_resolution (int or float) – resolution of frequency range

  • limit_modes (int) – number of modes used for FRF synthesis

  • modal_damping (float or None) – viscose modal damping ratio (constant for whole frequency range or None)

  • frf_type (str) – define calculated FRF type (receptance, mobility or accelerance)

add_noise(n1=0.001, n2=0.001, n3=0.0008, n4=0.0007)[source]¶

Additive noise to synthesized FRFs by random values as per standard normal distribution with defined scaling factors.

Parameters

  • n1 (float) – amplitude of real part shift scalied with FRF absolute amplitude

  • n2 (float) – amplitude of imag part shift scalied with FRF absolute amplitude

  • n3 (float) – amplitude of real part shift

  • n4 (float) – amplitude of real part shift

static loc_definition(response_point, response_direction, excitation_point, excitation_direction, rotation_included, all_at_once=False)[source]¶

Computation of DoF od specific node in specific direction to find location in modal matrix or global receptance matrix.

Parameters

  • response_direction – direction of observed responnce (0-x, 1-y, 2-z)

  • excitation_point (int or array(int)) – number of node where excitation is performed

  • excitation_direction (int or array(int)) – direction of performed excitation (0-x, 1-y, 2-z)

  • rotation_included (bool) – definition of roations inclusion in DoFs in system
